boundaryRules: Cross-module imports use index.ts exports; module-private files stay private
Modules call in-process functions; no internal HTTP, message broker or general event bus
Composition roots bind vendor adapters; no generic service locator or runtime plugin loader
One owner writes each table; application use cases coordinate existing local transactions
Pure domain code has no IO, clocks, Hono, Mastra or harness dependencies
Only contracts are a shared workspace package; ordinary product modules stay folders
